faq.q: What is the best time to visit Pelling?
faq.a: The best time to visit Pelling is Mar – Jun, Sep – Nov. Summers are 12–22°C and winters are 3–14°C.

The nearest airport is Pelling / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Siliguri Junction (66 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Pelling?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Pelling at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Pelling?
faq.a: Stays in Pelling start from ₹1,400 per night, with options across 5 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Pelling?
faq.a: The top attractions are Pemayangtse Monastery, Skywalk & Chenrezig Statue, Khecheopalri Lake.
